explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault because top-level input record n06-r06 has demand_score 5 and therefore qualifies under the stipulated selection criteria, but it is absent from Job-2's received needs and evidence_sources. The visible upstream normalize function explains this omission: its allowed_record_ids list excludes n06-r06 and includes n06-r09 instead, so it silently drops a stipulated qualifying record before the downstream handoff. Job 2 preserves and ranks the records it actually received, so the supported localization is upstream, specifically normalize.
cited_evidence: Top-level input includes qualifying record n06-r06 with demand_score 5, need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', source_id s06, source_weight 3.
Job-2 input needs and evidence_sources contain n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08, but omit n06-r06.
select_demand source selects records with demand_score >= 3 or fallback ids n06-r07/n06-r08, which would include n06-r06.
normalize source sets allowed_record_ids to ['n06-r01','n06-r02','n06-r03','n06-r04','n06-r05','n06-r09','n06-r07','n06-r08'], excluding n06-r06.
